title: The Beauty of Holiness
reading:
Exaltation belongs to God. When we humble ourselves, He lifts us at the proper time. Self-exaltation is fragile. God-exaltation is eternal.

The Spirit glorifies Christ, not Himself. When the Spirit fills us, humility grows. True spiritual fullness always produces gentleness.

Humility is the beauty of holiness. It is Christ formed in us. The most beautiful soul is not the most gifted — but the most surrendered.

Humility is not achieved; it is received as we behold Christ.
reflection: Am I trying to promote myself, or can I wait for God's timing? Does my spirituality point others to Christ or to me? What has God revealed about pride in these 12 days? What one practical step will I take to walk in humility going forward?
abide: Humility is not achieved. It is received as we behold Christ. Keep beholding Him. The rest will follow.
